title: Any true machine
statement: This is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with no work tapes and a single state, which is its initial state. On reading false, it moves the input head right and continues; on reading true, it outputs true and halts; and on reading a blank input cell, it outputs false and halts.
hypotheses_covered: Initial state is the unique state
